1.t: He Could See for the First Time! 👀 Jesus Heals the Blind Man #Shorts
1.d:
Jesus put mud on a blind man's eyes and said, "Go and wash!" Splash! For the very first time in his life, he could see! 👀 Comment JESUS OPENS MY EYES! 🙌

2.t: But Jesus Stopped! 💛 What Is Compassion? #Shorts
2.d:
Many people walked right past the blind man, but Jesus stopped! 💛 That is compassion: caring for others and helping them. Who will you help today? Comment I WILL HELP! 🙋
